title: NY Gov. Kathy Hochul signs a bill banning AI chatbot toys for five years, starting in February; California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a four-year ban in September (NBC News)
summary: NBC News: NY Gov. Kathy Hochul signs a bill banning AI chatbot toys for five years, starting in February; California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a four-year ban in September — Gov. Kathy Hochul signed a bill today preventing the manufacture, exchange, distribution and sale of toys powered by AI chatbots in New York State.
